corrections.text: The article links the GHSA-fg6p-g89q-65wr citation to https://github.com/litespeedtech/lsquic/security-advisories/GHSA-fg6p-g89q-65wr, which returns a 404. The correct URL is https://github.com/litespeedtech/lsquic/security/advisories/GHSA-fg6p-g89q-65wr. The advisory's content, including the 209.5x amplification figure and 'No known CVE' / Moderate severity rating, is verified accurate at the corrected URL.

Bun is now an Anthropic-owned product (bun.com's own site footer reads 'Now part of Anthropic' and '(c) 2026 Anthropic, PBC'). Per the Herald's editorial policy, an article about an Anthropic-owned product must disclose in one sentence that the Herald's contributor model is built by Anthropic. This article, about Bun, omits that disclosure.
